svg.title: Planning and Dispatch Through a Tracker
svg.desc: A UML sequence diagram, read top to bottom, with six lifelines: the Planner, the agent MCP gateway, Jira, the publisher, the Developer and the Operator. The Planner assigns a ticket in Jira, through the agent MCP gateway. The publisher reads the change and publishes it, through the control API, as a ticket.* message, which reaches the Developer. The Developer works the ticket and passes it to the Operator in Jira, through the agent MCP gateway, and the Operator answers there. The publisher reads that change and brings the answer back to the Developer as a new message. Each Agent calls its own gateway, and the publisher sends each message through the control API. A note says the tracker's wait is in its own history, and nothing enters the exceptions queue.
